messages:
Sam (Sales): Daily async — pipeline + security handoff for Vega Health. What I did: ran demo, sent infra diagram to their infra team, captured QPS/latency ask. Blockers: Vega needs HSM attestation + SOC2 artifacts before pilot. Today: coordinate with Eng & Security, update pilot checklist, push NDA to legal.

Marta (AE): Noted. Vega asked whether they can bring their own HSM (Thales). Is that supported on Private/Dedicated?

Pranav (Solutions Eng): We do support external KMS/HSM keywrap for Private and Dedicated but need network peering + IP allowlist and vendor/firmware details for compatibility testing. Also need expected QPS and peak token rates. @Jing (Security) can you confirm required artifacts?

Jing (Security): For on-prem HSM we require: CA cert chain, hardware attestation report, and an HSM audit log retention plan (>=90 days). Also want a segmented network diagram showing where HSM lives. We can only share detailed SOC2 artifacts after NDA. Ping me vendor docs and I'll review.

Leo (Sales Ops): I'm drafting the customer-facing pilot checklist. Sam, can you drop a concise bullet list of their asks so I can include in the one-pager?

Sam (Sales): Dropping list here: 1) HSM vendor + firmware version 2) Attestation report / cert chain 3) Expected sustained QPS + peak tokens/min 4) Data residency / region constraints 5) Signed NDA / MSA link. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/vega/pilot (internal-only).

Marta (AE): Vega also called out a latency SLO — average token gen latency ~150ms on their typical prompt mix (8k context). Any risk there?

Pranav (Solutions Eng): On Dedicated with the proposed GPU flavor + batching config we can hit that SLO for typical prompts. Need to plan a canary (prefix caching + smaller batch sizes for low-latency). I'll draft the config and perf numbers. Example canary nudge config snippet:

```
canary:
  instances: 2
  batch_target_tokens: 256
  max_latency_ms: 150
  prefix_cache: enabled
```

Pranav (Solutions Eng): Also created a draft PR for pilot infra + canary plan: https://git.internal/repo/pilot-config/pull/42

Sam (Sales): Thanks — blocker for me is NDA/legal and getting vendor docs. @Pranav can you have the canary plan ready by EOD so I can share with the customer?

Pranav (Solutions Eng): Yep, will finish the draft EOD and link perf numbers from internal bench.

Marta (AE): Quick legal question — Vega asked for SOC2 evidence. @Jing can Security share summary artifacts or steps to request them?

Jing (Security): We can provide a SOC2 summary report + MSA redacted. For more detailed artifacts we require NDA + a signed auditor access agreement (AAR). I'll coordinate with Legal to prepare the minimal set we can share. Also recommend adding a "no-remote-storage" clause for any sensitive tokens.

eng-deploy-bot: PR 42 created by Pranav — CI passed.

Leo (Sales Ops): I'll schedule a live sync with Vega for Thursday 11am PT. Please add agenda items: HSM compatibility checks, canary plan, latency SLO verification.

Pranav (Solutions Eng): I'll attend and bring bench numbers + test plan.

Marta (AE): Sounds good. Any other blockers before we push NDA? :thumbsup:

Sam (Sales): Blocker = waiting on Legal + Vega legal to sign NDA. Today I'll follow up with Legal and ping Vega for vendor docs. Will update thread when NDA lands. :rocket:
